name: Spec sync
description: Fires when a file under src/core is edited and asks the agent to check whether the related design document still matches, listing any drift. It only reports; it never edits files.

then.prompt: A file under src/core was edited. Find the spec in .kiro/specs/ that covers this module (frankendata-file-intake, frankendata-ai-stitching, frankendata-chat-sql, frankendata-autopsy, frankendata-recipes or frankendata-mcp) by matching the module path against each design.md module layout. Read that design.md and compare it with the edited code: module names and exports, SQL strategy, ids and naming conventions, constants, and error handling. List any drift as a short bullet list (what the design says, what the code does). If there is no drift, say so in one line. Do not modify any files.
